orientation_rotation.derivation: angle magnitude = atan(1/3); signed angle is clockwise from [-1,0,0] to [-3,1,0] about +[0,0,1]

record_semantics: Each record is one alternative one-H calculation; records are not simultaneous occupancies.
reconstruction_rule: Retain all source atoms with type != 2 and add only the selected type-2 H row.

construction.host_selection: retain every source atom with type != 2
construction.added_atom_selection: retain only source type-2 atom with id 120

zpe_contribution.definition: Three-mode local H zero-point energy in the frozen calculation geometry.

solution_energy_zpe_corrected.definition: Reported frozen solution energy corrected by the site-H and H2 zero-point-energy terms.

bader_charge_transfer_as_reported.definition: Reported H Bader charge-transfer value, preserved without sign or reference-state conversion.

zpe_contribution.definition: Three-mode local H zero-point energy evaluated about the non-frozen relaxed geometry.

solution_energy_zpe_corrected.definition: Reported non-frozen solution energy corrected by the site-H and H2 zero-point-energy terms.

bader_charge_transfer_as_reported.definition: Reported H Bader charge-transfer value, preserved without sign or reference-state conversion.

charge_density.definition: Total charge integrated over the candidate-H Voronoi region in the H-free host, divided by that region's Voronoi volume.

minimum_nearest_neighbor_distance.definition: Shortest distance from the candidate H position to a host atom.

closest_neighbor_element.definition: Element identity of the closest host atom.

voronoi_volume.definition: Volume of the candidate-H Voronoi region in the H-free host.

surface_area.definition: Sum of triangular convex-hull face areas.

volume_cuberoot.definition: Cube root of the Voronoi volume.

area_over_volume.definition: Convex-hull surface area divided by Voronoi volume.

elongation_lambda1_over_lambda3.definition: Ratio of largest to smallest PCA eigenvalue of the void vertices.

anisotropy_lambda2_over_lambda3.definition: Ratio of middle to smallest PCA eigenvalue of the void vertices.

rout_over_rin.definition: Maximum divided by minimum vertex radius relative to the vertex centroid.
